purpose: Frozen logits cache format for the W12 real 1,145,814-record cohort. NOT yet populated; this file defines the contract that preflight.py validates.
status: CONTRACT ONLY - no real patient data present

patient_id.note: patient-level blocking key; all bootstrap / splits must be disjoint on this field

group_meta.note: Observable deployment metadata only; used for group-structured calibration, never for label leakage

split.note: patient-level disjoint; no patient may appear in two splits

lead_names.mimic_known_issue: MIMIC-IV-ECG aVF/aVL are swapped relative to the canonical order; must be remapped by name before any forward pass

label_semantics.code15_rule: 173,347 CODE-15% records (50.13%) are neither one of six abnormalities nor normal; they MUST NOT be treated as confident negatives

n_eff.note: n_rec / deff; all inference must use patient-block bootstrap, not record-level

invariants: n_rec = 1,145,814 for the full cohort (MIMIC-IV-ECG 800,035 + CODE-15% 345,779)
n_patient ~ 395,122; n_rec is NOT the independent sample size
no patient_id appears in more than one split
lead alignment by name, never by channel index
unlabeled / ambiguous records carry ambiguous_flag=true and are excluded from confident-negative training
checkpoint weights and logits cache are hash-pinned before any calibration experiment
all calibration experiments run on cached logits with ZERO GPU after one frozen forward pass
blocked_until: PhysioNet credentialed DUA approval for MIMIC-IV-ECG v1.0
clinical collaborator review of label ontology
